Reference: configuration object

The configuration object is validated before it is stored. Unknown keys are rejected rather than ignored.

Fields

name
A label shown in menus. One to sixty-four characters, unique.
endpoint
An absolute address. Secure transport is required except for a local server.
timeoutMs
Milliseconds before the request is abandoned. Between five thousand and three hundred thousand.

Example

{
  "name": "Home server",
  "endpoint": "https://models.example.test/v1/chat",
  "timeoutMs": 60000
}

Invalid values produce a message naming the field that failed validation.

The reference is generated from the same schema the product validates against, so the two cannot drift.

The sidebar carries navigation and advertising, which should never be translated as content.
